title: BNCI 2020-002 Attention Shift (Covert Spatial Attention) dataset
description: EEG recordings from 18 healthy participants performing a gaze-independent brain-computer interface task based on covert spatial attention shifts. Participants answered yes/no questions by shifting attention to a green or red cross while keeping central gaze fixation, evoking N2pc-type ERP responses. The dataset (30 EEG channels plus EOG, 250 Hz) supports evaluation of canonical correlation analysis-based classification for binary communication BCIs.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a BrainAmp DC amplifier and Ag/AgCl electrodes (extended 10-20 montage, right mastoid reference, 250 Hz sampling, 0.1 Hz high-pass). Colored crosses (green + and red x) were presented for 250 ms with an SOA of 850 ms (jittered), ten stimuli per trial, across 7 blocks. Participants shifted covert attention to the cross matching their yes/no answer while maintaining central fixation.
